$about: Figures for the A5 and A6 design mockups, 9 November 2026. Every value is copied from the named published document; nothing is estimated. Burnley charges checked against the PDF on 9 November 2026 (hash matches data/local-bills/burnley-2026-27.json). RA values are those in data/national/budget.json, which the live game page also carries. The example guess figures are marked as fixtures: they stand for a player's input and are not published figures.
